canonical_project: Webel Purulia data centre / data storage facility
owner: West Bengal Electronics Industry Development Corporation Limited (Webel)
notes: Telegraph India reported on 2025-01-11 that Webel already runs two similar data-storage centres in Calcutta and Purulia while opening its Siliguri data centre. Webel tender archives refer to establishment of high-performance data center infrastructure at Monibhandar and DR site Purulia; a West Bengal PHE progress page also lists Webel migration/upgradation work against Purulia. Capacity not disclosed.
